programme.desc: (1955) Cold War-influenced western starring Glenn Ford and Edward G Robinson. A smallholder stands alone against the expansionist plans and brutal tactics of a tyrannical rancher.

programme.desc: (1950) Western with Randolph Scott and Dorothy Malone. A cunning US Marshal pretends to be a doofus to get a bank robber to take him to the hidden loot.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: (2015) Matt Damon stars in Ridley Scott's drama about an astronaut who accidentally gets left behind on Mars. Oops. How will he survive and how on earth can he get home?

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: (2013) Sci-fi comedy with Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Martin Freeman, Eddie Marsan and Paddy Considine. Can five pub crawlers save the world?

programme.title: Ride Lonesome

programme.title: Flamin' Hot

programme.title: Battleship

programme.title: Smile
